doc: Attacker -> defender damage multiplier HINTS. 1.5 = strong, 1 = neutral, 0.5 = resisted. Games may rescale. If A is strong into B, B is resisted by A (0.5) except the Light/Shadow rivalry, where both are strong. Same element is resisted.

Fire.why: Fire cannot burn what is already burning.

Water.why: Water resists Fire: water douses flames.

Lightning.why: Fire burns Lightning as well as anything else.

Earth.why: Earth resists Fire: dirt and stone smother flames.

Wind.why: Wind fans the flames, but it does not burn.

Nature.why: Fire burns through leaves, roots and bark.

Light.why: Fire burns Light as well as anything else.

Shadow.why: Fire burns Shadow as well as anything else.

Poison.why: Fire burns Poison as well as anything else.

Metal.why: Forge heat softens steel and cooks whoever wears it.

Arcane.why: Fire burns Arcane as well as anything else.

Ice.why: Ice resists Water: cold freezes water solid.

Lightning.why: Lightning resists Water: water conducts every volt.

Earth.why: Floods erode stone and turn soil to mud.

Wind.why: Water splashes Wind without special effect.

Nature.why: Nature resists Water: roots drink the water up.

Light.why: Water splashes Light without special effect.

Shadow.why: Water splashes Shadow without special effect.

Poison.why: Poison resists Water: toxins taint the water.

Metal.why: Water slowly rusts metal; on its own it barely dents it.

Arcane.why: Water splashes Arcane without special effect.

Fire.why: Fire resists Ice: heat melts ice in seconds.

Ice.why: Ice is already as cold as it gets.

Earth.why: Frost cracks stone over winters, not seconds.

Wind.why: Freezing air goes heavy and still.

Nature.why: Frost kills leaves and stops growth.

Light.why: Light resists Ice: sunlight melts ice.

Metal.why: Metal resists Ice: steel shatters brittle ice.

Fire.why: Lightning hits Fire for normal damage.

Ice.why: Lightning hits Ice for normal damage.

Lightning.why: A charged target has nowhere to send more charge.

Earth.why: Earth resists Lightning: earth grounds the charge harmlessly.

Wind.why: Lightning splits open the storm sky.

Nature.why: Nature resists Lightning: wood does not conduct; vines absorb the jolt.

Light.why: Lightning hits Light for normal damage.

Shadow.why: Lightning hits Shadow for normal damage.

Poison.why: Lightning hits Poison for normal damage.

Arcane.why: Arcane resists Lightning: arcane bends raw energy to its will.

Water.why: Water resists Earth: floods erode stone and turn soil to mud.

Ice.why: Stone hits Ice as hard as anything.

Earth.why: Stone meets stone. Very little happens.

Wind.why: Wind resists Earth: endless wind erodes rock to sand.

Nature.why: Nature resists Earth: roots crack stone apart.

Light.why: Stone hits Light as hard as anything.

Shadow.why: Stone hits Shadow as hard as anything.

Poison.why: Soil soaks up and filters toxins.

Metal.why: Ore and stone are old relatives.

Arcane.why: Stone hits Arcane as hard as anything.

Fire.why: Wind feeds fire as much as it hurts it.

Water.why: Wind buffets Water like anything else.

Ice.why: Ice resists Wind: freezing air goes heavy and still.

Lightning.why: Lightning resists Wind: lightning splits open the storm sky.

Earth.why: Endless wind erodes rock to sand.

Wind.why: Wind into wind just makes a breeze.

Nature.why: Wind bends trees, but they bend back.

Light.why: Wind buffets Light like anything else.

Shadow.why: Wind tears the shadow veil to shreds.

Metal.why: Wind buffets Metal like anything else.

Arcane.why: Arcane resists Wind: runes bind the air in place.

Fire.why: Fire resists Nature: fire burns through leaves, roots and bark.

Ice.why: Ice resists Nature: frost kills leaves and stops growth.

Lightning.why: Wood does not conduct; vines absorb the jolt.

Wind.why: Vines and thorns treat Wind like anyone.

Nature.why: Plants share; they do not feed on each other.

Light.why: Plants love sunlight; light hits them normally.

Shadow.why: Shadow resists Nature: without sun, plants wither.

Poison.why: Poison resists Nature: blight rots living things.

Metal.why: Vines and thorns treat Metal like anyone.

Arcane.why: Vines and thorns treat Arcane like anyone.

Fire.why: Light hits Fire with no bonus.

Water.why: Light hits Water with no bonus.

Lightning.why: Light hits Lightning with no bonus.

Earth.why: Light hits Earth with no bonus.

Wind.why: Light hits Wind with no bonus.

Nature.why: Light feeds plants as much as it hurts them.

Metal.why: Metal resists Light: polished steel throws light back.

Arcane.why: Arcane resists Light: arcane twists light into illusions.

Wind.why: Wind resists Shadow: wind tears the shadow veil to shreds.

Light.why: Darkness swallows light: the eternal rivalry.

Earth.why: Earth resists Poison: soil soaks up and filters toxins.

Wind.why: Wind resists Poison: gales blow toxic clouds away.

Light.why: Light resists Poison: pure light cleanses toxins.

Poison.why: Venomous things are immune to their own venom.

Fire.why: Fire resists Metal: forge heat softens steel and cooks whoever wears it.

Water.why: Steel slices water to no effect, but no harm done either.

Lightning.why: Lightning resists Metal: metal is a lightning rod.

Earth.why: A pickaxe works, but stone is stubborn.

Wind.why: A blade cuts Wind as usual.

Nature.why: A blade cuts Nature as usual.

Shadow.why: A blade cuts Shadow as usual.

Poison.why: Poison resists Metal: acid corrodes armour.

Metal.why: Steel on steel rings, but holds.

Lightning.why: Arcane bends raw energy to its will.

Wind.why: Runes bind the air in place.

Shadow.why: Shadow resists Arcane: shadow devours spellwork.

Metal.why: Metal resists Arcane: cold iron breaks enchantments.

Arcane.why: Matching runes cancel each other out.
